overview:
I am a Professor of Medicine at the University of Alabama at Birmingham Heersink School of Medicine, and an attending physician at the Birmingham, Alabama VA Health Care System.  

For over two decades I have delivered primary care and addiction care  to persons who experience homelessness, addiction, and pain. I also  lead and collaborate in VA- and NIH-funded research on care for vulnerable populations. 

My homeless-focused research focuses on optimizing primary care service delivery and housing interventions.

I also have a special interest in understanding the care, safety and suicide risk of patients with long-term chronic pain. I co-host the podcast "On Becoming a Healer", which focuses on fostering healing relationships in medicine.

I can be followed on Twitter at @StefanKertesz
